subject: English
question_text: Complete the text adding suffixes, prefixes or the both with the root words given in the
stimulus: parentheses. 1×5= 5 English is used as a common language for global (a) ----- (communicate) -----. As it is used in more than sixty countries officially, it is regarded as an (b) ----- (national) ----- language. As an Independent nation, we have to maintain our political, commercial and cultural relations with the rest of the world through English. Thereby. English (c) ----- (wide) ----- the opportunity to deal with globalized world. It promotes international relationship and (d) - ---- (brother) -----. For being a global citizen, there is no alternative to English. A good command of English is essential to get a good job with better salary. In short, English is a must for (e) ----- (flourish) ----- in life.
guide_solution: Adding suffix, prefix or both: (a) communication; (b) international; (c) widens; (d) brotherhood: (e) flourishing.
